linux.source:
#!/bin/bash -l
#$ -P welfgr
#$ -pe omp 4
#$ -l h_rt=00:30:00
#$ -l mem_per_core=4G
#$ -j y
set -euo pipefail
export TASK_ROOT=<scc-task>
module purge
module load gcc/12.2.0 python3/3.12.4
export CARGO_HOME=<scc-user>/fereg-rust-1.85.1/cargo
export RUSTUP_HOME=<scc-user>/fereg-rust-1.85.1/rustup
export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.85.1
export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
export CC=gcc CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 FEREG_TEST_THREADS=4
export FEREG_BUILD_DATE=2026-10-21 FEREG_GIT_COMMIT="$(python3 -c 'import json,os; from pathlib import Path; print(json.loads((Path(os.environ["TASK_ROOT"])/"original-source.json").read_text())["fereg"][:12])')"
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TASK_ROOT/build-original-linux-cache"
export RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$TASK_ROOT=/build/cmg-upgrade --remap-path-prefix=<scc-user>=/build/user --remap-path-prefix=<scc-home>=/build/home"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1
test ! -e "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR"
test ! -e "$TASK_ROOT/artifacts/Linux/original-public.plugin"
cd "$TASK_ROOT/sources/original-public"
verify_source() {
  python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,os
from pathlib import Path
meta=json.loads((Path(os.environ['TASK_ROOT'])/'original-source.json').read_text())
for name,digest in meta['source_files_sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
PY
}
verify_source
./scripts/build_linux.sh
verify_source
cp dist/fereg_linux.plugin "$TASK_ROOT/artifacts/Linux/original-public.plugin"
sha256sum "$TASK_ROOT/artifacts/Linux/original-public.plugin"
printf 'POLICY_ORIGINAL_LINUX_BUILD_COMPLETE\n'

mac.source:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export TASK_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
export PATH="$TASK_ROOT/python/bin:<user-home>/.rustup/toolchains/1.85.1-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"
export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.85.1 FEREG_BUILD_DATE=2026-10-21
export FEREG_GIT_COMMIT="$(python3 -c 'import json,os; from pathlib import Path; print(json.loads((Path(os.environ["TASK_ROOT"])/"original-source.json").read_text())["fereg"][:12])')" CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 FEREG_TEST_THREADS=4
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TASK_ROOT/build-original-mac-cache"
export RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=<user-home>=/build/user --remap-path-prefix=$TASK_ROOT=/build/cmg-upgrade"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1
test ! -e "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR"
test ! -e "$TASK_ROOT/artifacts/Darwin/original-public.plugin"
cd "$TASK_ROOT/sources/original-public"
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,os,signal,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
meta=json.loads((Path(os.environ['TASK_ROOT'])/'original-source.json').read_text())
def verify():
    for name,digest in meta['source_files_sha256'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
verify()
process=subprocess.Popen(['bash','scripts/build_macos.sh'],start_new_session=True)
try:
    rc=process.wait(timeout=1200)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
    process.wait()
    raise
if rc:
    raise SystemExit(rc)
verify()
PY
cp dist/fereg_macos.plugin "$TASK_ROOT/artifacts/Darwin/original-public.plugin"
shasum -a 256 "$TASK_ROOT/artifacts/Darwin/original-public.plugin"
printf 'POLICY_ORIGINAL_MAC_BUILD_COMPLETE\n'

purpose: One held-out complete-native-command development comparison of the selected gates; no qualification or model reselection.

rules.failure: retain every call and failure; no scientific/native retry or extra sampling based on speed; no fitting/reselection
rules.inference: descriptive development comparison only, separate 42-cell qualification remains required
rules.linux_analysis_unit: one isolated physical host; two mirrored solves do not create independent hosts
rules.mac_analysis_unit: one active-desktop block; ordinary noise retained
rules.scored_clock: NATIVE_SECONDS around complete native call, no diagnostic tracing
rules.warmups: all retained; diagnostic/resource/gate traces only on existing warmup calls

linux.source:
#!/bin/bash -l
#$ -P welfgr
#$ -pe omp28 28
#$ -l num_proc=28
#$ -l h_rt=04:10:00
#$ -l mem_per_core=3G
#$ -j y
set -euo pipefail
TASK_ROOT=<scc-task>
module purge
module load python3/3.12.4
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 LC_ALL=C PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
TASK_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
REPO="$(cd "$TASK_ROOT/../../.." && pwd)"
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 LC_ALL=C PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
exec "$TASK_ROOT/python/bin/python3.13" "$REPO/bench/two_fe_policy_development.py" run "$TASK_ROOT/policy-gates/development-plan-Darwin.json" --output "$TASK_ROOT/policy-gates/development-Darwin"
